dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL-NOS; ICD-10-CM C83.30, SNOMED CT 109969005), non-germinal-center B-cell (non-GCB) phenotype by the Hans algorithm.

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: non-GCB (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1 positive in ~70% of cells, Hans algorithm)

stage_iii.quote: Lugano stage III with splenic involvement (IIIS), PET-CT staged (2026-09-05), equivalent to Ann Arbor III2-S; bulky; B symptoms present.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: the spleen is a lymphatic organ, so splenic involvement is annotated 'S' and does not make this stage IV

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: The 11 cm retroperitoneal mass meets the >=10 cm definition of bulky disease.

mn_stage_iv.quote: the spleen is a lymphatic organ, so splenic involvement is annotated 'S' and does not make this stage IV

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: extranodal sites >1 = 0 (spleen is a lymphatic organ, not an extranodal site) - total 2.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: IHC double expressor - MYC protein in ~50% of tumor cells (>=40%) and BCL2 protein in ~80% (>=50%); ... FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is NOT double-hit/triple-hit disease

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is NOT double-hit/triple-hit disease

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: Two adverse biologic features: (1) IHC double expressor - MYC protein in ~50% of tumor cells (>=40%) and BCL2 protein in ~80% (>=50%)

prog_ipi_3.quote: International Prognostic Index 2 (low-intermediate risk) and NCCN-IPI approximately 3 (high-intermediate risk)

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI = 3 points: age >60 (1), LDH above ULN (1), stage III (1); no points for ECOG >=2, >1 extranodal site, or kidney/adrenal involvement

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Six cycles of polatuzumab vedotin + R-CHP (pola-R-CHP) every 21 days, started as soon as possible after the tumor board

tx_pola_preferred.quote: he is advanced stage (III) with IPI 2, which is exactly the POLO population in which NCCN lists pola-R-CHP as a preferred regimen for previously untreated DLBCL with IPI 2-5

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Deauville 4-5 (partial metabolic response) requires biopsy of the residual FDG-avid site to distinguish residual lymphoma from scar/inflammation, and a positive biopsy triggers salvage chemoimmunotherapy and transplant or CAR-T as above

mn_non_curative.quote: He is fit enough for full-dose curative therapy.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not substitute DA-R-EPOCH-R (no MYC/BCL2 rearrangement)

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: Therefore I do not see an indication for dose reduction, for a less intensive regimen, or for a geriatric- oncology pathway

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: resolved HBV infection, no antiviral prophylaxis required, but anti-HBc reactive therapy warrants monitoring

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: hepatitis B DNA quantitation and continued HBsAg/anti-HBc/anti-HBs monitoring (resolved HBV infection, no antiviral prophylaxis required, but anti-HCV therapy warrants monitoring)

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: resolved HBV infection, no antiviral prophylaxis required, but anti-CD20 therapy warrants monitoring

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Intermediate CNS relapse risk; CNS prophylaxis is indicated and a brain MRI is required before treatment.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: give intrathecal cytarabine plus methotrexate (with dexamethasone) with each of the 6 systemic cycles, or per institutional protocol on cycle days 1 and 4

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 4-6 weeks after cycle 6 (~February-March 2027): Deauville 1-3 is complete metabolic response (Lugano CR)

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 (partial metabolic response) requires biopsy of the residual FDG-avid site to distinguish residual lymphoma from scar/inflammation, and a positive biopsy triggers salvage chemoimmunotherapy

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis given bulky disease with rising LDH and uric acid at the upper limit of normal: allopurinol 300 mg daily starting 2 days before cycle 1 and continuing through cycle 1, oral/IV hydration aiming for urine output >2 mL/kg/h, and twice-weekly monitoring of uric acid, potassium, phosphate, calcium and creatinine

sup_gcsf.quote: Growth factor support is mandatory: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 of every cycle (age >60, bulky disease, and the polatuzumab/R-CHP backbone all confer high neutropenia risk).

work_echo_reviewed.quote: his baseline echocardiogram is normal (LVEF 58%, GLS -20%), so full-dose doxorubicin is appropriate

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit enough for full-dose curative therapy.

miss_hbv_dna.quote: No quantitative HBV DNA and no repeat HBsAg/anti-HBc/anti-HBs after 2026-09-03 (anti-HBc reactive with anti-HBs reactive suggests resolved infection); monitoring plan for anti-CD20 therapy is not documented.
